html:
Unique Research · Event / study-tour signup · September 20, 2023 · KEEP event signup CTA

AI is no longer abstract—ChatGPT marked an “iPhone moment” for the Fourth Industrial Revolution. Founders hunting frontier tech and scenes: Unique Capital launches its first U.S.–China AI Study Tour—witness OpenAI’s first DevDay while exchanging with U.S. peers on tech and landing trends.

Itinerary spans coasts (Silicon Valley → New York): visit leading AI companies; attend OpenAI DevDay; meet builders at NVIDIA, Anthropic, Runway, Hugging Face, ULC; talk U.S. AI investing at Insight Partners; visit Stanford, Princeton, and landmarks. A rare go-global networking trip—join us on the path of AI inquiry.

Stops & why

  • OpenAI — GPT / DALL·E / Whisper; first DevDay Nov 6 expectations: GPT progress, API improvements, Codex/tools, beneficial applications. Founded 2015 SF (Musk et al.), $1B start; RL roots → pretrained-model era; Meta/Stability open cousins followed.
  • NVIDIA HQ (Santa Clara) — Jensen Huang; invented GPU 1999; full-stack (HW/system/platform/apps); >1B CUDA GPUs; 3M+ developers; 10k startups; AI transforming gaming, healthcare, transport (~$100T addressable narrative in CN brief).
  • Anthropic — 2021 OpenAI alumni (Dario Amodei) focused on AI safety vs commercialization worries; Claude 2 file/code; bar/GRE/coding/GSM8k score lifts; Constitutional AI (principles for self-critique)—less harmful, more transparent, more scalable than pure RLHF labeling.
  • Stanford — SAIL + 2019 HAI (Fei-Fei Li & John Etchemendy); US News AI grad Top 3 with CMU/MIT; track system for AI/biocomputing.
  • Intel Museum — Noyce building; Moore’s Law / chip history; Intel pivoting data-centric (AI, 5G, edge); 2022 revenue $63.1B.
  • Runway — Forbes AI 50; Google-led ~$100M D; Gen-2 text→video; tech behind Everything Everywhere All at Once.
  • Insight Partners (NY) — >$90B AUM (Feb 2022); 750+ investments; 50+ IPOs; Fund XII $20B; tickets $5M–$500M; cyber/IT-architecture growth focus.
  • ULC Robotics — RaaS pioneer for energy/utilities since 2001; custom robots + ML to cut O&M cost under regulation.
  • Hugging Face — Transformers library → “GitHub of ML”; 100k+ models, 10k+ datasets; open culture; widely used in China fine-tunes.

Signup: seats limited — contact Unique Capital / Unique Research event team to apply for the U.S.–China AI Study Tour. Travel with peers who are building AI products for both markets.

10 CN images; attach on ingest.

— END —
